TranslationContext: This file contains Unit Names for the Abyssal Demons Faction.

Translations.Comment: 深淵 = abyss, 悪魔 = demons. Dark, menacing tone for demonic creatures from the darkest depths.
蝰 = venomous snake/viper. Maintains sense of sinister serpentine nature.
悪魔の子 = children/spawn of devils. Lesser demonic infantry with crude, threatening sound.
疫病 = plague/pestilence, 歩み手 = walker. Disease-bearing demons that spread corruption.
小鬼 = small demon/imp. Diminutive form suggesting weaker plague-carrying creatures.
火炎 = flames/fire. Emphasizes demonic and fiery nature in fantasy wargame style.
蠅 = fly/flies. Creates disturbing image of flying plague-bearing insect creatures.
刈り手 = reaper/one who harvests. Death-dealing demonic harvesters of souls.
猟犬 = hunting hound. Hellish beasts that hunt with demonic purpose.
地獄 = hell, 騎手 = rider. Demonic cavalry with infernal authority.
巨体 = massive form/colossus. Emphasizes enormous plague-infected monstrosity.
大 = great/arch-, 悪魔 = devil. Suggests leadership and greater demonic power.
公爵 = prince/duke. Noble yet dark title for powerful demonic ruler.
伝令 = herald/messenger. Conveys both divine authority and abyssal origin.
